beats.care: Ride or drive via Bibwewadi or Satara Road? Add a few minutes and follow the U-turn near Aranyeshwar bus stop.
beats.what: From Monday, right turns toward Swargate are banned at Chandralok Chowk, Pushpamangal Chowk and Utsav Hotel Chowk. Drivers must use set U-turns.
beats.why: Underground metro work between Swargate and Katraj has squeezed these roads. Police want traffic to keep moving.

cards.body: From Upper Bibwewadi, turn left and U-turn near Aranyeshwar bus stop. At Pushpamangal Chowk, go straight and U-turn near Adinath Society.
cards.title: Your new U-turns

opts: To ease jams during underground metro work
cards.q: Why did police change turns around Market Yard?
cards.why: DCP (Traffic) Sandeep Bhajibhakre said the changes are for the Swargate–Katraj underground metro work.

cards.body: This is the second round of curbs for this metro line. Heavy vehicles were already barred near Katraj Chowk from October 17.

hook: Why can't you *turn right toward Swargate* near Market Yard now?

learn.t: The new changes are a trial, so police can tweak them. They stay 'until further orders', with no end date.

sources.name: Punekar News
sources.title: Traffic Changes in Market Yard, Bibvewadi, Satara Road for Swargate-Katraj Pune Metro Work

tldr: Pune Traffic Police have banned several right turns around Market Yard and Bibwewadi for the Swargate–Katraj underground metro work.
